Programming Language Reference: HTML (HyperText Markup Language)
Version: HTML Living Standard (WHATWG / W3C)
Syntax: Tag-based markup language structuring web documents using elements, attributes, and text nodes.
Semantics: Semantic markup elements ( , , , , , ) parsed into the Document Object Model (DOM).
Type System: Markup tree hierarchy of DOM Nodes (Element, Text, Comment, Document).
Memory Model: Browser DOM tree in C++ heap, managed via garbage collector linked with JavaScript runtime.
Concurrency: Declarative resource loading with async and defer attributes on , web workers.
Error Handling: Forgiving parser: graceful error recovery specification ensuring document renders despite malformed tags.
Standard APIs: DOM API, Canvas API, WebGL API, Web Audio API, WebRTC
Specification: WHATWG HTML Living Standard (https://html.spec.whatwg.org/)
Official Docs: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML
